name: Channel owner interview article and video

mentions.name: Channel owner interview article and video
mentions.description: This project turns a three-hour interview with the owner of a roughly 500K-subscriber YouTube channel into a text-based interview article and a more detailed video version, for publication on the author's website and YouTube channel.
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently had a three hour chat with the owner of a massive channel (about 500K subs), and I'm currently trying to edit that down to both a text based interview article and a somewhat more detailed video version.
